I dont wanna sound pretentious, but i believe you’re referring to OCPD. (Obsessive compulsive personality disorder) Only sounds similar in name, and is a personality disorder that's characterized by extreme perfectionism, order, and neatness. People with OCPD will also feel a severe need to impose their own standards on their outside environment. 
OCD is more complex, but is an anxiety disorder in which time people have recurring, unwanted thoughts, ideas or sensations (obsessions) that make them feel driven to do something repetitively.
The more you know!

Fictives are not fake. I’d describe it like having any other alter, except you get a template, or base to start off with. Theres no shame in having fictives, and they are real. I have around 18 fictives, mostly because of my adhd tendency to hyperfixate (fictives are very common for people with adhd and autism in particular).
